info.name: ADAPTIX local demo - customer API
info.description:
GET and POST checks for the LOCAL DEMO customer API (python -m adaptix.localdemo service).

Request 2 reads the live contract and stores the current lookup field (customer_id at baseline, or the renamed field after a schema change, e.g. client_id) in the collection variable keyField. The POST requests then use it, and request 4 checks what happens when a caller still sends the OLD field.

Import into Postman (File > Import), or run from a terminal:
  npx newman run postman/ADAPTIX-local-demo.postman_collection.json
Change baseUrl if the service runs on another port.

exec: pm.test('service and demo database are ready', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ok'));
pm.test('unknown request fields are refused (additionalProperties false)', () => pm.expect(req.additionalProperties).to.eql(false));
console.log('live lookup field:', key, req.properties[key]['x-renamed-from'] ? '(renamed from ' + req.properties[key]['x-renamed-from'] + ')' : '(baseline)');

item.name: 3 POST lookup with the live field

exec: pm.test('the API applied exactly the value sent', () => pm.expect(b.query[key]).to.eql(101));
pm.test('customer identity: id 101, Asha Verma', () => { pm.expect(b.customer[key]).to.eql(101); pm.expect(b.customer.full_name).to.eql('Asha Verma'); });

item.name: 4 POST lookup with the original field (customer_id)

exec: pm.test('baseline schema: the original request still works (200)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('schema drift: the original request is rejected with 422', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));
pm.test('422 names the new required field as missing', () => pm.expect(d.some(e => e.type === 'missing' && e.loc[1] === key)).to.be.true);
pm.test('422 names customer_id as no longer permitted', () => pm.expect(d.some(e => e.type === 'extra_forbidden' && e.loc[1] === 'customer_id')).to.be.true);

item.name: 5 POST lookup for a customer that does not exist
6 POST lookup with the wrong type

exec: pm.test('type error reported for the field', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail[0].type).to.eql('integer_type'));
